summary: HSPnetPage is a foundational web page class for the HSPnet system, responsible for managing user session, initialization, culture settings, client asset loading, Google Analytics, session timeout handling, dynamic navigation, user-specific UI, error and warning panels, and footer generation. It contains robust workflows for session management, security, and client feedback, heavily relying on dynamic JavaScript and server-side logic to maintain a secure, responsive user experience.
purpose: To provide a secure, standardized, and localized web page experience for HSPnet users, handling user session validation, timeouts, UI assets, navigation, and dynamic feedback panels (errors/warnings), ensuring user activity is tracked and managed, and presenting session and user-related information in the page footer.

workflows.name: Session Validation & Initialization
steps: OnInit: Set startTime, initialize culture, instantiate or retrieve UserSession.
If UserSession is invalid, redirect to timeout page.
Save UserSession object for later access.
Set thread culture and date formats based on locale and HSPnet standards.
Set up Google Analytics if configured.
Set up global assets and scripts (CSS and JavaScript).
Set up session timeout warning logic unless login/forgot password page.

workflows.name: Session Timeout Warning Workflow
steps: Calculate timeout and warning intervals.
Inject dynamic JS to client for dialog popup on session expiry.
Repeated AJAX calls to ManageSession.asmx (CheckSession/ResetSession) using session hash.
Show countdown, warning dialog (pop-up), and allow reset/close by user.
Clear JS intervals and redirect on actual timeout.

workflows.name: Error and Warning Panel Workflow
steps: Process page errors and warnings via UserSession.Messages.
Display errors and warnings in scrollable panels, format bold sections, adjust panel location if both present.
Add client JavaScript to allow panels to be hidden.
Warnings processed after errors, dynamically offset warning panel.

workflows.name: Footer Generation Workflow
steps: Build footer with copyright, version, user identity, agency/department, role, last login, timezone.
Append session info and last login, handle switched user/read-only state.
Show load time as HTML comment.

workflows.name: Navigation Initialization Workflow
steps: Initialize menu expansion states from cookies per section.
Build left navigation based on session/user.

business_rules: If UserSession is invalid, must redirect user to timeout page.
Default locale is applied if not present in query or database.
Session timeout warning dialog only shown if user is not on login or forgot password page.
Session expiry must clear all interval timers and redirect user.
Panel errors are processed and displayed before warnings, panels can be hidden.
validations: URL hash must be validated for non-login screens.
UserSession validity check (IsValid) on every page load.
Locale string must match allowed values or fallback to database/default.
Panel controls (Panel, Label) must not be null before processing.
calculations: Timeout intervals (mRefRate, sRefRate) based on UserSession properties.
Warning panel vertical offset: 50 + (20 * number of errors).
Footer load time: endTime - startTime in seconds and milliseconds.
conditions: If UserSession is null or invalid, create new session and/or redirect.
If session hash is not present, do not perform AJAX session checks.
If error count != 0, adjust warning panel offset and visibility.
If switched user or view-only mode, append specific footer notice.
system_behavior: Injects required global assets (CSS, JS) via server code.
Injects Google Analytics script dynamically if tracking ID is present.
Handles session timeout warnings via client-side JS and AJAX.
Displays feedback panels for errors/warnings, dynamically formatted.
Navigation menus expand/collapse based on user cookie state.
Footer is dynamically constructed based on session/user details.
dependencies: Resources class for localization and strings
jQuery, jQuery UI, Popper, Tippy, FontAwesome, custom JS/css
exceptions: Session timeout or invalid session: Redirect to timeout page.
Panels are not displayed if no errors or warnings exist.
AJAX errors logged to console, dialog closed gracefully.
content_gaps: No detailed field validation logic for individual input fields (besides session and panels).
Underlying structure of HSPnetSession and UserSession.Messages not present.
Exact error/warning message formats and localization resources not included.
Some referenced external scripts and CSS files not described.
